description: This file contains the implementation of the NoteService interface, using Spring Data JPA. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting Note entities in a backend service.

classes.name: NoteServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the NoteService interface that manages Note entities using Spring Data JPA, providing CRUD operations.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new Note entity from the request data and saves it to the repository.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Note entities from the repository.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a Note by its ID, returning an Optional<Note>.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Note identified by ID with data from the update request.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes the Note with the specified ID if it exists.
